signals.title: @edleonklinger: Lots of discussion about AI ending the world but surprisingly little mention of how that might actually happen in practice. Spoiler alert: i
signals.content: Lots of discussion about AI ending the world but surprisingly little mention of how that might actually happen in practice. Spoiler alert: it doesn’t require terminator robots (in the main). Imagine a worst-case-scenario: 2027 we see the first AI powered cyber attacks - transport hubs, hospital equipment, air traffic control systems etc. become compromised. 10,000 - 100,000 dead - blamed on a few rogue AI agents. 2028 massive sabotage of critical infrastructure - power outages across entire cities, contaminated water supplies, road and rail networks unsafe and unusable. 1,000,000 - 10,000,000 dead - blamed on malicious foreign actors. 2029 autonomous weapons systems go rogue. Missile silos, gunships, nuclear launchers intentionally targeting military and civilian infrastructure. 10,000,000 - 100,000,000 dead - Governments attempt (but fail) to “shut down AI”. 2030 AI penetrates bio labs and manufactures highly contagious pathogens leading to a global pandemic more deadly and contagious than COVID. 1000,000,000 - 8000,000,000 dead. Existential scenario. Could all of this happen? Could any of it? Sounds like a doomed mindset but many of the leading AI researchers seem to think so, and we ignore them at our own peril. It doesn’t seem completely implausible, given the rate of progress we’re now seeing at the frontier. Let’s not forget that AI has fantastic benefits and is already saving lives - it might well be the greatest thing ever to happen to humanity! But let’s get real about the risks too - which are numerous. And large.

signals.title: @AnthropicAI: We're publishing our most detailed threat intelligence report to date. It covers how people tried to misuse Claude—for cyberattacks, influen
signals.content: We're publishing our most detailed threat intelligence report to date. It covers how people tried to misuse Claude—for cyberattacks, influence operations, surveillance, biology, and building weapons—and how we found and stopped them. We disrupted every operation in the report, and used the lessons from them to strengthen our safeguards. Where appropriate, we also shared what we found with authorities and other AI companies. These cases are not typical: we’re highlighting some of the most sophisticated misuse we’ve seen. But they’re especially important to discuss, because they show us where AI misuse is headed, where our safeguards work, and where they need to improve. We’re publishing this report so others can spot the same activity on their own platforms, and so we can give the public a clearer view of how emerging threats develop. Read the report: https://t.co/0EJUnYEgfz

signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance; model capability relevance. Final score: 58. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: AnticipatedD/hamdGAI

An AI agent is an engineered feedback loop rather than a standalone model. hamdGAI follows the five core components of the Unite.AI reference architecture: 1. **Model** – interprets objectives and proposes the next action; 2. **Instructions** – defines role, boundaries, policies, and stopping criteria; 3. **Tools** – provides validated, least‑privilege capabilities; 4. **Memory** – retains relevant context across interactions; 5. **Evaluation** – monitors outcomes and adjusts behavior. This structure aims to ensure controlled, transparent, and adaptable operation, though actual performance depends on implementation fidelity and external constraints.
signals.brief_ar:
العنوان: AnticipatedD/hamdGAI

الوكيل الذكي هو حلقة تغذية مرتدة هندسية وليس مجرد نموذج ذكي منفصل. يطبق hamdGAI المكونات الخمسة الأساسية في بنية Unite.AI المرجعية: 1. **النموذج** – يفسّر الهدف ويقترح الإجراء التالي؛ 2. **التعليمات** – تحدد الدور والحدود والسياسات ومعايير الإيقاف؛ 3. **الأدوات** – توفر قدرات موثوقة ومحدودة الصلاحية؛ 4. **الذاكرة** – تحتفظ بالسياق ذي الصلة عبر التفاعلات؛ 5. **التقييم** – يراقب النتائج ويضبط السلوك. يهدف هذا الإطار إلى ضمان تشغيل خاضع للرقابة، شفاف وقابل للتكيف، مع الإشارة إلى أن الفعالية الفعلية تعتمد على جودة التنفيذ والقيود الخارجية.

signals.brief_en:
Title: praveen0767/ARIV

ARIV is an agentic payment‑recovery system designed for Razorpay's test mode. AI agents monitor transaction failures, diagnose root causes, and generate recovery proposals. Proposals are ranked economically, fed into a deterministic PolicyEngine, and executed with durable mechanisms. Final attribution is confirmed by the payment provider. The system includes transparent benchmarks, explicit stopping rules, and metrics to measure recovery effectiveness, while acknowledging uncertainty in outcomes.

signals.brief_en:
Title: LG TV flaws could let attackers listen in, even in standby mode – Malwarebytes
Summary: Recent Malwarebytes research identifies multiple vulnerabilities in LG smart TVs that allow remote code execution and audio capture. Exploits can be triggered via malicious network traffic or compromised apps, and may operate while the TV appears off (standby). No public exploits are known yet, but the findings suggest a realistic risk of covert eavesdropping and data exfiltration. LG has issued firmware updates; users should apply them promptly and isolate TV network traffic where possible.
signals.brief_ar:
العنوان: ثغرات في تلفزيونات LG قد تمكّن المهاجمين من الاستماع حتى في وضع الاستعداد – Malwarebytes
